audit.whatIsWrong: The entry names no Aurora ability except Twofold Hex, has her slots backwards, and invents a root. Real kit: Across the Veil (W) is the leap that turns her invisible on landing, 22/21/20/19/18s; The Weirding (E) is the ranged blast that slows and hops her backward, 15s at rank 1; Between Worlds (R) damages, slows and leaves a zone. Nothing in her kit roots.
audit.why: The text told the player to bait 'her E blink' and quoted a 16s number that belongs to neither ability, and wants.foe[2] told them Aurora roots them out of Stand United — she has no root, and a slow does not interrupt a channel.
audit.corrected: Leap renamed Across the Veil with its 22s rank-1 cooldown, The Weirding named as the slow-and-hop, the root removed, and Spirit Abjuration named as the sustain that Grievous Wounds answers.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are a holding pattern — her poke still outranges your trade initiation, but your Ki Barrier shields absorb meaningful chunks of her burst whenever you do land a taunt. The critical discipline is tracking her E cooldown on every wave: Aurora blink is roughly 16 seconds, so count it visually and only commit Shadow Dash when you know she cannot blink out of the taunt. At Level 6 Stand United rewrites the lane entirely — you can hand her the wave freely and use the time to swing a bot-lane fight or peel a collapsing mid-laner, and her poke advantage in the local lane converts to zero if you generate a kill or objective elsewhere. From this point the lane is won on the macro clock, not on trading.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are a holding pattern — her poke still outranges your trade initiation, but your Ki Barrier shields absorb meaningful chunks of her burst whenever you do land a taunt. From this point the lane is won on the macro clock, not on trading.
